sqlMap.select:
SELECT DISTINCT A.BUYER, A.DOC_NO, A.KEY_1 AS APPR_ID, A.KEP_2 AS SYSTEM_ID, CASE WHEN A.BUYER IN ('KRHANW0100') THEN ( SELECT MAX(CD2.TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 CD1, ICOMCOD2 CD2 WHERE CD1.TYPE = 'C001' AND CD1.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND CD1.CODE = (SELECT MAX(ADD_USER_DEPT) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = A.KEP_4) AND CD2.TYPE = 'PLNT' AND CD2.COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND CD2.CODE = CD1.TEXT5 ) ELSE (SELECT MAX(TEXT4) FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002' AND TEXT1 = A.BUYER) END AS COMPANYID, A.KEP_4 AS PR_NO, A.BUYER, A.KEY_5 AS INSTANSID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER IN (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'PLNT' AND COMPANY_CODE = 'KRHANWG002') AND A.KEY_9 IS NULL AND A.KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND A.IF_FLAG NOT IN ('E','N')
AND A.KEP_3 = 'PR'
AND A.CREATE_DATM > TRUNC(SYSDATE - 60) AND ROWNUM <= 100

SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY, B.DOCU_NO, B.PASS_STATUS, B.EXTIF_TP, B.EXTIF_NO, B.EXTIF_COUNT, B.CUR_ORDER_NO, (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = C.COMPANY AND USER_ID = C.USER_ID) AS USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOGDOCU B , ICOGPASSLN C WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY AND A.DOC_NO = B.DOCU_NO
AND C.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND C.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = C.COMPANY AND USER_ID = C.USER_ID) = #USERID#
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOGPASSLN A SET A.PASS_DATE = TO_DATE(#PASS_DATE#, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , A.REFER_DATE= TO_DATE(#PASS_DATE#, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') , A.PASS_KN = #PASS_KN# , A.PASS_ADD = #PASS_ADD# WHERE A.COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE COM_CODE = A.COMPANY AND USER_ID = A.USER_ID) = #USER_ID#
sqlMap.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(ORDER_NO) AS ORDER_NO FROM ICOGPASSLN WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND PASS_TP = #PASS_TP# AND PASS_KN IS NULL ORDER BY TO_NUMBER(ORDER_NO)

SELECT DISTINCT C.BUYER, C.PR_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOMTRGW B , ICOMPRDT C WHERE A.KEY_1 = #APPR_ID#
AND A.BUYER = B.COM_CODE AND A.DOC_NO = B.TARGET
AND B.COM_CODE = C.BUYER AND B.KEY_1 = C.REF_NO
sqlMap.update:
UPDATE ICOMPRDT SET RECV_FLAG = #RECV_FLAG# , CHANGE_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') , CHANGE_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')
WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO#
UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET CUR_ORDER_NO = #CUR_ORDER_NO# , PASS_STATUS = #PASS_STATUS# WHERE COMPANY = #COMPANY# AND DOCU_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND PASS_STATUS != #PASS_STATUS#
UPDATE EAI.IF_APL_SEND SET KEY_3 = #APPRLINESTATUSCD# , KEY_4 = #COMMENT# WHERE BUYER = #COMPANY# AND DOC_NO = #DOCU_NO# AND USER_ID = #USER_ID#
UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND SET KEY_8 = #RTN_MSG# , KEY_9 = #RTN_FLAG# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID#

UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET PASS_STATUS = #PASS_STATUS# , END_DATE = #END_DATE# WHERE (COMPANY, DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# AND CREATE_DATM > TO_DATE('20220320', 'YYYYMMDD') ) AND PASS_STATUS NOT IN ('1','3')
UPDATE ICOGDOCU SET PASS_STATUS='4' , END_DATE = #END_DATE# WHERE (COMPANY,DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# )

UPDATE ICOGPASSLN SET PASS_KN='4' , PASS_ADD=#PASS_ADD#
WHERE (COMPANY,DOCU_NO) IN ( SELECT BUYER, DOC_NO FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# )

UPDATE ICOMBDGT A SET A.TEMP_AMT = A.TEMP_AMT - (SELECT NVL(SUM(TARGET_QTY * TARGET_PRICE),0) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND BUDGET_DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE = A.DEPT||A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND PLAN_AMT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY BUDGET_DEPT , ACCOUNT_TYPE ) WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE IN ( SELECT BUDGET_DEPT||ACCOUNT_TYPE FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND PLAN_AMT_FLAG = 'Y' GROUP BY BUDGET_DEPT , ACCOUNT_TYPE ) AND (SELECT MAX(ADD_DATE) FROM ICOMPRDT WHERE BUYER = #BUYER# AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# ) BETWEEN A.FROM_DATE AND A.TO_DATE

UPDATE ICOGPASSLN A SET A.PASS_KN = #PASS_KN# WHERE A.COMPANY = #BUYER# AND A.DOCU_NO = #DOC_NO# AND A.ORDER_NO = (SELECT MAX(B.ORDER_NO) FROM ICOGPASSLN B WHERE A.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND A.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND B.PASS_TP != '2')
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO ICOMTRXL (DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10) VALUES ('HNWH_PO',#BUYER#,#PR_NO#,FUN_MAX_SEQ_MNG('HNWH_PO', 'YY'), 'R', #STATUS2#, ' ', #INSTANSID#, ' ' ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS'), 'N',' ' )
